sentence: This project builds soft surgical robots made from shape-memory alloy that can move safely inside the human body and handle soft tissue.
This project studies how bacterial proteins that work together make complicated molecules, and what makes these proteins stable and active.
This project designs small radar transceivers that use machine learning to give sharper images and work in all weather conditions.
This project searches for rare signals of physics beyond the Standard Model in particle collisions, using machine learning.
This project gets a benchtop instrument that uses a magnetic field to help work out the structure of molecules.
This project builds a statewide network that links academic institutions, industry and agencies and shares research facilities and computing resources.
This project tests a software application that helps travelers plan trips and rewards transportation choices with lower impacts.
This project develops smart protective equipment with sensors that monitor vital signs, and studies how materials respond to heat.
This project studies how to represent a collection of related genomes compactly so that genome analysis is easy to compute and accurate.
This project studies how immune cells such as macrophages and dendritic cells respond to the mechanical properties of engineered nanoparticles.
This project supports meetings that link water treatment and water quality with topics such as artificial intelligence and quantum computing.
This project develops ways to make shell programs run faster without needing help from the people who write them.
This project builds planning methods that let teams of robots change their surroundings to finish tasks in unknown places.
This project builds swarms of tiny magnetic particles and steers them through fluids and complex surroundings with a magnetic source.
This project works on research problems in cybersecurity and artificial intelligence, including software security and how people interact with artificial intelligence.
